I'm sorry if this has been asked already, but I couldn't find an answer to this, and it's been on my mind for a while.

When a Hero can choose which damage type they inflict (such as Mr Fixer, depending on his fighting style), are they allowed to choose "irreducable"?

The current rulebook actually has a compete list of the available damage types on the bottom of page 7:

"The Sentinels of the Multiverse damage types are: cold, energy, fire, infernal, lightning, melee, projectile, psychic, radiant, sonic, and toxic"

It also mentions that "Damage can be irreducible, regardless of its type."

 

(Oddly, it neglected to include Fluffy Bunny damage. )

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I had a pet bunny named snowball.  It was white and fluffy.  It was also an evil spawn of some forsaken plane of eternal darkness.

It refused to eat carots, celery or lettuce.

It preferred to eat (in order) Carpet, furniture, Human Flesh, plastic, Chicken Wire, bread.

It actually ate the plastic water bottle, that hung on the outside of its cage.

Eventually it escaped the house and a neighborhood Dog ate it.
